# Vendored sources

- `zygisk.hpp`: official Zygisk module sample, API v4, commit
  `7bb941ac8edfcffd1d23761e401c45ca95409dc1`, original ISC notice retained.
  Source: https://github.com/topjohnwu/zygisk-module-sample
- `cJSON.c`, `cJSON.h`: cJSON v1.7.19, MIT, license in `cJSON-LICENSE`.
  Source: https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/v1.7.19

No Zygisk Next/ReZygisk/NeoZygisk implementation or binary is bundled.
